messages:
ana: Quick design check — proposing we collapse surface/density tokens into three tiers: `dense`, `regular`, `spacious`. Goal: simpler token surface for console tables, modals, and toasts. Thoughts? cc @katie @mike

katie: I like three tiers, but we should avoid name collisions with the existing `compact` token. Suggest labels: `Compact density`, `Default density`, `Spacious density` (user-facing). Dev token names can stay short.

mike: Accessibility flag — reduced vertical spacing can cause focus rings to overlap neighbors on high-contrast themes. We should ensure focus outlines are always visible (maybe increase z-index on focus or add a subtle outline offset).

jordan: For modals: keep internal padding aligned with table row height so forms don't feel cramped. Also, toasts should never sit over actionable form fields (z-index ordering + pointer-events).

samir: Accessibility nit — toasts are not consistently announced by screen readers in the console. We should add `role="status"` + `aria-live="polite"` and an optional visually-hidden label so NVDA/VoiceOver pick up the content. Also test on iOS Safari.

ana: (typo correction) ana: ^^ noted re: aria. For copy tweaks: current toggle label is just `Compact`. Proposing `Compact density` and tooltip: "Reduce vertical spacing for dense lists and tables." That makes intent clearer.

katie: Mapping/migration concern — we'll need a small migration doc that maps old tokens to the new tiers (and note deprecated names). I'll draft it.

mike: Implementation note + fallback example: keep legacy aliases for two releases. Runtime should map missing tokens to the closest tier. Example mapping snippet:

```json
{
  "--spacing-compact": "--spacing-dense",
  "--surface-low": "--surface-elevation-1"
}
```

ops-bot: Deploy preview for `density-tokens` branch succeeded — https://staging.redwood.dev/density-preview :rocket:

jordan: I put a tiny visual exploration in a gist for now (will add figma soon): https://gist.github.com/example/density-mocks — shares spacing table + modal mock.

samir: Quick reminder: NVDA + Safari Mobile historically missed `aria-live` if element inserted with display: none -> block. Ensure toasts are inserted in DOM in a way that screen readers detect (visibility:hidden -> visible sometimes fails).

ana: (again typo) ana: Actionables: @katie draft migration notes + deprecation timeline, @mike implement aliases + unit tests, @jordan update figma and drop final comps in #design-files, @samir run AT matrix on NVDA/VoiceOver (desktop + iOS). I'll update the token RFC and ping eng for review.

katie: I'll take the migration doc — aiming EOD Thursday.

mike: I'll add alias mapping and a small test that renders focus states at `dense` density.

jordan: Figma updated and shared in #design-files. Left comments on modal padding variants.

ana: (again) ana: Thanks all :clap: If anyone hits a blocker on the dev side, drop it here and we'll triage.

katie: One last tiny copy nit — toast close button label should be `Dismiss notification` for screen readers, rather than just `Close`.
